fact: On 3 August 2026 the Directeur des Examens et Concours announced that the CEP 2026 statements of marks can be downloaded from emp.educmaster.bj: schools log in and search a candidate by matricule or table number, and parents log in to a parent account, with credentials obtained from the child's school, to see their children's CEP results.
title: Mise à disposition des relevés de notes du CEP 2026
publisher: Ministère des Enseignements Maternel et Primaire
